inputs.finding: Pinned treatment/control semantics reproduce on a pure target but block-order state drift can inflate apparent effect; after PR226 reconciliation only pre-state/order equivalence and sham-control stability remain incremental candidate gaps.

PR226 already covers probe identity, non-broadcast input equality, exact intervention broadcast binding, complete recipient receipt coverage and same-output negative adjudication. Do not impose all-recipient-UPTAKEN semantics.
Current PR226 ABI can express withheld/no-broadcast control but cannot express broadcast-bearing shuffled-recipient or semantic-placebo controls; full DoWhy dependency is not justified.
Open/not-merged candidate source exposes only INTERVENTION_BROADCAST and CONTROL_NO_BROADCAST arm conditions and has no explicit pre-state/order/seed or sham-repeat witness.

do_not_import: DAG or statistical estimate as truth/effect authority
preserve_current_g3: zero runtime/truth/effect authority from component result

two_minimal_incremental_hypotheses.proposal: Add a shared matched-probe context witness external to the arm payload, carrying pre-state/reset/seed/order equivalence evidence sufficient to reject state/order contamination without pretending hidden state is observed.
two_minimal_incremental_hypotheses.reason: CITCOM E3 produced a deterministic block-order false positive; PR226 has input equality but no explicit state/order equivalence witness.
two_minimal_incremental_hypotheses.falsifier: Canonical WP507 E4 tests show current G3 already rejects the state/order counterexample or the added witness rejects no new false-positive class.

two_minimal_incremental_hypotheses.proposal: Keep CausalProbeArm's intervention/no-broadcast binary semantics stable and evaluate a separate optional typed negative-control primitive for sham-repeat, semantic-placebo and recipient-shuffle probes rather than widening CONTROL_NO_BROADCAST to carry broadcast identity.
two_minimal_incremental_hypotheses.reason: DoWhy E3 shows broadcast-bearing negative controls are not representable in the current arm ABI; a separate primitive avoids semantic overloading and keeps canonical causal adjudication fail-closed.
two_minimal_incremental_hypotheses.falsifier: E4 shows no incremental discriminatory value over the existing intervention/no-broadcast pair, or the extra control surface increases ambiguity/complexity more than it rejects false attribution.

coordination_and_blocker.duplicate_work_rule: Do not claim another generic WP507 scout or another DoWhy/CITCOM E3 objective.

trigger4_handoff_hypothesis: When WP507 G3 is reconciled to canonical main, run one bounded E4 matrix on the existing implementation: baseline G3 plus (A) pair-context witness and (B) separate typed negative-control witness. Cases: state/order drift, no-broadcast repeat drift, semantic placebo broadcast, recipient shuffle, valid partial uptake with complete receipt coverage, unchanged-output negative, and clean positive. Adopt only deltas that reject a new false-positive class while preserving existing valid cases.
evidence_boundary: Architecture fusion of two E3 source-equivalent results plus open PR source read; no E4, canonical merge, runtime or whole-system promotion.
